records.name: Vertical linear mark
records.claim: A thin bright upright bar appears along the left side of the dark visible region.
records.reason: 밝은 세로 영역은 보이는 창의 오른쪽에 있는데 왼쪽이라고 설명했다.
records.definition: A narrow, elongated contrast run oriented mainly vertically inside the visible window. It defines local orientation and linearity, not position, exact length, brightness polarity, thickness variation, or hidden continuation.

records.name: Horizontal linear mark
records.claim: A short pale horizontal segment is visible near the lower-left of the window.
records.reason: 밝은 가로 영역은 창의 위쪽에 있는데 왼쪽 아래라고 설명했다.
records.definition: A narrow, elongated contrast run oriented mainly horizontally inside the visible window. It excludes diagonal orientation, exact position, brightness polarity, and hidden continuation.

records.name: Oblique linear mark
records.claim: A clean pale diagonal slash rises across the dark visible region.
records.reason: 왼쪽 아래에서 오른쪽 위로 향하는 밝은 대각선이 보인다.
records.definition: A narrow contrast run with a clearly diagonal or slanted orientation. It defines obliqueness and linearity, not position, exact slope, brightness polarity, or hidden continuation.

records.name: Curved arc or hook
records.claim: A small pale rounded arch appears near the center.
records.reason: 밝은 영역이 어두운 부분 위를 둥글게 감싸는 arch 형태가 보인다.
records.definition: A visibly curved contrast mark forming part of an arc, rounded bend, or hook. It excludes straight angular corners, exact curvature, position, polarity, and hidden continuation.

records.name: Angular bend or corner
records.claim: A short upright contrasting mark ends in a small angled foot.
records.reason: 위쪽으로 좁아지는 밝은 영역은 보이지만 별도의 각진 발 모양이 있는지는 불분명하다.
records.definition: Two or more contrasting runs meet with a visibly angular turn, corner, or kink. It excludes smooth curvature, exact angle, position, polarity, and hidden continuation.

records.name: Small loop or ring
records.claim: A tiny pale oval-like ring encloses a dark center.
records.reason: 아래쪽이 열려 있어 어두운 중심을 완전히 둘러싼 ring이라는 설명은 맞지 않는다.
records.definition: A compact contrasting contour that visibly encloses a darker center or forms a near-closed loop. It excludes open arcs without enclosure, exact loop shape, position, polarity, and unseen continuation.

records.name: Stroke junction
records.claim: Two short contrasting runs meet in a small crossing-like mark.
records.reason: 중앙의 밝은 연결부는 보이지만 두 개의 짧은 획이 교차한다고 단정하기는 어렵다.
records.definition: A compact location where multiple contrasting runs meet or cross, producing an X-, T-, Y-, or plus-like junction. It excludes merely adjacent parallel runs and does not define the branch angles or polarity.

records.name: Compact filled block
records.claim: A solid dark square-like region occupies most of the visible window.
records.reason: 창 전체가 검정인 것은 맞지만 사각형의 외곽은 관찰창이 만든 모양이다.
records.definition: A contiguous compact region occupying several neighboring pixels without a clearly dominant thin-stroke direction. It defines local filledness, not whether the region is light or dark, exact size, position, or hidden continuation.

records.name: Light stroke fragment
records.claim: A small bright upright mark appears near the center of the dark visible area.
records.reason: 창 안에 위아래로 뻗은 밝은 영역이 보인다.
records.definition: A compact connected group of light pixels forming a stroke-like mark inside the visible window. It defines the foreground mark itself, but not its orientation, curvature, branching, thickness, intensity, or continuation beyond the window.

records.name: Predominantly dark field
records.claim: The visible square is nearly uniformly black.
records.reason: 창 왼쪽 위에 넓은 밝은 영역이 있어 거의 균일한 검정이라는 설명과 다르다.
records.definition: A visible window whose pixels are almost entirely dark, with no substantial light stroke present. It describes the observed pixel field only and does not infer whether it is background or a filled object.

records.name: Vertical stroke orientation
records.claim: The bright fragment is taller than it is wide and runs mainly vertically.
records.reason: 밝은 영역의 주된 길이 방향이 세로다.
records.definition: A local light mark whose dominant extent is vertical. This defines directional orientation only; the mark may be straight, curved, thick, thin, or connected to other marks.

records.name: Horizontal stroke orientation
records.claim: The light fragment extends mainly from left to right.
records.reason: 창 아래쪽에 좌우로 뻗은 밝은 구간이 보인다. 위쪽의 다른 밝은 영역까지 모두 가로라는 뜻으로 해석하지 않았다.
records.definition: A local light mark whose dominant extent is horizontal. This defines directional orientation only and excludes its exact shape, thickness, and endpoint form.

records.name: Diagonal stroke orientation
records.claim: A bright slanted segment crosses the visible area.
records.reason: 왼쪽의 짧은 세로 조각과 오른쪽 위 조각이 보이며 창을 가로지르는 밝은 대각선은 없다.
records.definition: A local light mark whose dominant axis is oblique rather than vertical or horizontal. It defines slanted direction only and excludes whether the mark is straight, curved, or part of a junction.

records.name: Curved stroke trajectory
records.claim: The bright mark bends into a small arc on the right side.
records.reason: 오른쪽의 밝은 영역은 거의 곧은 세로 띠이며 작은 arc로 휘었다는 근거가 없다.
records.definition: A light stroke following a visibly bent or arc-like path rather than a single straight axis. It defines curvature of the visible path, not enclosure, branching, or the hidden continuation outside the window.

records.name: Angular bend
records.claim: The bright mark includes a short bar joined to a differently oriented segment.
records.reason: 왼쪽 아래의 작은 밝은 조각만 보여 두 선분이 각을 이루며 만나는지 구별하기 어렵다.
records.definition: A visible light mark that changes direction through a distinct corner or kink. It defines a two-segment or sharply turning relationship, excluding smooth curvature and multi-arm junctions.

records.name: Multi-arm junction
records.claim: Several light segments appear to meet in a compact central region.
records.reason: 아래쪽의 작은 밝은 덩어리 하나이며 여러 arm이 만나는 junction은 보이지 않는다.
records.definition: A visible point or compact region where at least two light stroke arms meet or overlap. It defines the branching or crossing relationship, not the arms' individual orientations or brightness.

records.name: Loop-like enclosure
records.claim: A small rounded light contour encloses a dark center.
records.reason: 밝은 획 사이의 어두운 영역은 위아래로 열려 있어 둘러싸인 중심이라는 설명은 맞지 않는다.
records.definition: A light curved path that visibly surrounds or nearly surrounds a darker interior area. It defines local enclosure, including incomplete loop-like contours, but not the precise loop size, orientation, or stroke thickness.

records.name: Dark stroke fragment
records.claim: A short dark horizontal stroke-like fragment is visible near the center of the window.
records.reason: 대부분 넓은 어두운 영역이고 밝은 픽셀은 아래 경계에 있다. 중앙의 짧은 어두운 가로 획은 식별되지 않는다.
records.definition: A compact connected group of visibly dark pixels forming a narrow or path-like mark within the retained window. It defines the dark mark's presence and stroke-like character, but not its orientation, curvature, branching, thickness, or continuation outside the window.

records.name: Dark filled fragment
records.claim: A nearly solid dark rectangular patch occupies part of the visible window.
records.reason: 넓은 어두운 영역은 보이지만 직사각형이라는 외곽은 대부분 창 경계가 만든다.
records.definition: A compact contiguous dark region with substantial area, appearing more block-like or filled than stroke-like within the retained window. It defines the local filled dark mass, but not its exact size, position, boundary shape, or hidden continuation.

records.name: Light filled fragment
records.claim: A compact bright horizontal block occupies part of the visible window.
records.reason: 위쪽의 밝은 가로 영역은 보인다. 이를 compact block으로 보는 외곽은 세 면에서 관찰창에 의해 잘려 있다.
records.definition: A compact contiguous region of visibly light pixels with substantial area, appearing block-like or filled rather than primarily path-like. It defines the local light mass, but not its exact size, position, boundary shape, intensity, or continuation beyond the visible window.

records.name: Dark loop-like enclosure
records.claim: A small dark rounded contour encloses a lighter interior.
records.reason: 실제는 밝은 테두리와 어두운 중심인데 어두운 테두리가 밝은 내부를 감싼다고 반대로 설명했다.
records.definition: A visibly dark curved path that surrounds or nearly surrounds a lighter interior area. It defines local enclosure by a dark contour, but not the precise loop size, orientation, thickness, degree of completion, or hidden continuation.

records.name: Visible-window edge contact
records.claim: A narrow dark mark visibly reaches the left edge of the retained window.
records.reason: 왼쪽을 채운 넓은 검정 영역은 있지만 좁은 어두운 mark는 식별되지 않는다. 창 접촉 자체를 concept으로 삼았다.
records.definition: A visible light or dark mark whose pixels meet an edge of the retained 8x8 window. It defines boundary contact only, not polarity, orientation, thickness, topology, or any continuation beyond the masked window.

records.name: Linear stroke fragment
records.claim: Two short elongated marks are visible near the upper part of the window.
records.reason: 위쪽의 밝은 가로 구간 위아래에 짧게 길어진 어두운 구간들이 보인다.
records.definition: A narrow elongated contiguous mark visible inside the 8x8 window. It defines line-like geometry, while orientation, polarity, thickness, position, length, and whether other marks are attached remain separate.

records.name: Dark-valued mark
records.claim: The two visible short bars are dark-valued.
records.reason: 위쪽에서 지목할 수 있는 짧은 가로 구간들은 주변 밝은 띠보다 어둡다.
records.definition: A visible mark whose pixels are distinctly darker than the neutral gray level inside the window. It defines tonal polarity only, not the mark's shape, orientation, size, or count.

records.name: Light-valued mark
records.claim: A narrow light upright mark is visible at one side of the window.
records.reason: 반복되는 밝은 가로 띠가 보이며 한쪽의 좁은 세로 mark는 없다.
records.definition: A visible mark whose pixels are distinctly lighter than the neutral gray level inside the window. It defines tonal polarity only, not the mark's shape, orientation, size, or count.

records.name: Horizontal orientation
records.claim: The visible bars run approximately left to right.
records.reason: 위쪽의 짧은 띠들은 대체로 좌우 방향이다.
records.definition: The principal direction of an elongated visible mark is approximately horizontal. It defines orientation, while tonal polarity, thickness, length, and the number of marks remain outside the definition.

records.name: Vertical orientation
records.claim: A narrow dark mark runs vertically.
records.reason: 밝은 면 오른쪽에 좁은 어두운 세로 구간이 보인다.
records.definition: The principal direction of an elongated visible mark is approximately vertical. It defines orientation, while tonal polarity, thickness, length, and the number of marks remain outside the definition.

records.name: Diagonal orientation
records.claim: A small oblique fragment is visible.
records.reason: 주된 대비 경계는 세로이며 작은 대각선 획은 식별되지 않는다.
records.definition: The principal direction of an elongated visible mark is oblique rather than horizontal or vertical. It defines slanted orientation, while tonal polarity, curvature, thickness, and length remain separate.

records.name: Curved or rounded stroke
records.claim: A small bent or curved fragment is visible.
records.reason: 세로 경계 위쪽에 약한 휘어짐은 있지만 별도의 휜 획인지는 불분명하다.
records.definition: A visible mark with a bend, arc, hook, loop, or rounded termination rather than a purely straight segment. It defines curvature, not polarity, exact radius, size, or attachment.

records.name: Compact filled region
records.claim: A pale compact block with internal texture is visible.
records.reason: 오른쪽의 밝은 textured 영역은 보인다. compact block의 외곽은 여러 면에서 관찰창에 의해 잘린다.
records.definition: A small contiguous region with substantial width and height and relatively little internal separation, appearing block-like rather than line-like. Exact tone, position, and boundary shape are outside the definition.

records.name: Parallel-stroke bundle
records.claim: Two dark horizontal bars appear as a closely spaced parallel pair.
records.reason: 위쪽 밝은 구간을 사이에 두고 어두운 가로 구간들이 나란히 놓여 있다.
records.definition: A recurring arrangement of at least two separate linear stroke fragments with similar direction and a small gap between them. The defining factor is the parallel relationship, not a particular polarity or orientation.

records.name: Crossed or clustered stroke texture
records.claim: A compact dark textured mark contains several tightly packed directions.
records.reason: 밝은 대각선과 넓은 어두운 면이 보이며 여러 방향의 어두운 획이 밀집한 texture는 식별되지 않는다.
records.definition: A compact group of multiple short marks with differing directions, crossings, or tightly interleaved pixels, without a single dominant filled block. The grouping relationship is essential; exact polarity and stroke count are not.

records.name: Vertical stroke
records.claim: A short narrow light-and-dark mark runs mainly vertically near the left side of the visible window.
records.reason: 세로 대비 구간은 보이는 창의 오른쪽에 있는데 왼쪽이라고 설명했다.
records.definition: A narrow contrast-bearing mark whose visible major axis is predominantly vertical within the 8×8 window. It defines vertical orientation and stroke-like continuity; tone polarity, exact width, intensity, bends, parallel repetition, loops, and continuation outside the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Horizontal stroke
records.claim: A short nearly horizontal dark mark is visible in the small window.
records.reason: 위쪽에 짧은 어두운 가로 구간이 보인다.
records.definition: A narrow contrast-bearing mark whose visible major axis is predominantly horizontal within the 8×8 window. It defines horizontal orientation and stroke-like continuity; tone polarity, exact width, intensity, bends, parallel repetition, loops, and continuation outside the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Diagonal stroke
records.claim: A small oblique contrast mark slopes across the visible window.
records.reason: 대각선 방향의 밝기 대비 구간이 보인다.
records.definition: A narrow contrast-bearing mark whose visible major axis is oblique rather than predominantly vertical or horizontal. It defines diagonal orientation and stroke-like continuity; exact slope, tone, width, curvature, crossings, and continuation outside the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Angular turn or junction
records.claim: A vertical mark meets a short adjoining segment, forming a small angular corner.
records.reason: 주로 세로 경계가 보이며 작은 가로 연결이 별도의 corner인지 확정하기 어렵다.
records.definition: A visible stroke geometry in which a segment changes direction or two segments meet, producing an L-, V-, or T-like corner. It defines the angular relationship among segments; exact orientations, tone, thickness, number of branches, and hidden continuation are outside its definition.

records.name: Rounded or loop-like mark
records.claim: A tiny outlined rounded or loop-like mark is visible.
records.reason: 위쪽의 밝고 어두운 작은 무늬에서 독립된 둥근 contour를 특정하기 어렵다.
records.definition: A visibly curved arc or small loop/ring-like enclosure in the retained window. It defines rounded curvature or enclosure; exact closure, tone polarity, thickness, size, and continuation beyond the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Parallel-band group
records.claim: Two short nearly parallel horizontal bands are visible.
records.reason: 밝고 어두운 가로 띠가 나란히 반복된다.
records.definition: Two or more nearby contrast-bearing bands with approximately parallel local orientation. It defines multiplicity and parallel spacing; the individual band orientation, tone polarity, exact count, thickness, and whether the bands continue outside the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Compact filled or textured patch
records.claim: A small pale checker-like square cluster is visible.
records.reason: 밝은 texture는 있지만 checker 무늬인지는 불분명하고 square 외곽은 관찰창에서 생긴다.
records.definition: A dense, compact roughly block-like cluster of contrasting pixels without a clearly dominant single stroke, bend, or loop. It defines local density and compact extent; tone polarity, exact texture, internal microstructure, and hidden shape outside the window are outside its definition.

records.name: Crossing strokes
records.claim: Two oblique marks visibly intersect in a small cross-like arrangement.
records.reason: 하나의 대각선 띠가 보이며 두 획의 교차는 없다.
records.definition: Two visible stroke segments intersect or overlap, producing a clear crossing or cross-like junction. It defines the intersection relationship; stroke orientation, tone, thickness, number of crossings, and hidden continuation are outside its definition.

records.name: Vertical linear mark + Angular bend or corner
records.claim: The visible mark is an upright segment ending in an angular foot.
records.reason: 밝은 세로 영역은 보이지만 끝부분의 각진 발과 그 연결을 구별하기 어렵다.
records.combination: A_C001 describes the upright segment; A_C005 describes the change of direction at its termination, and the two roles connect at the visible corner.

records.name: Vertical linear mark
records.claim: A mostly vertical bright bar appears in the dark window.
records.reason: 밝은 세로 띠가 실제로 보인다.
records.combination: The single role describes the visible vertical linearity.

records.name: Oblique linear mark
records.claim: A pale diagonal slash crosses the visible dark region.
records.reason: 밝은 대각선이 보인다.
records.combination: The single role describes the oblique linear segment.

records.name: Horizontal linear mark
records.claim: A short pale horizontal segment is visible near the lower-left.
records.reason: 가로 방향의 밝은 구간은 보인다. 왼쪽 아래가 전체 이미지 기준인지 보이는 창 기준인지 명시하지 않아 위치 주장은 불분명하다.
records.combination: The single role describes the horizontal linearity.

records.name: Curved arc or hook
records.claim: A small rounded pale arch appears near the center.
records.reason: 밝은 둥근 arch가 보인다.
records.combination: The single role describes the visible smooth curvature.

records.name: Small loop or ring
records.claim: A tiny pale loop encloses a dark center.
records.reason: 밝은 곡선 아래쪽이 열려 있어 enclosed center라는 표현은 지지되지 않는다.
records.combination: A_C006 describes the near-closed contour and its enclosed center.

records.name: Stroke junction
records.claim: A compact crossing-like mark is visible.
records.reason: 중앙의 넓은 밝은 연결부는 있지만 독립된 여러 획의 교차인지는 모호하다.
records.combination: The single role describes the meeting of multiple visible runs.

records.name: Compact filled block
records.claim: A solid dark square-like region fills much of the visible window.
records.reason: 전부 검정인 창을 맞게 기술했지만 square-like 외곽은 mask 경계에서 생긴다.
records.combination: The single role describes compact filledness without assigning semantic foreground or background.

records.name: Stroke junction
records.claim: A small cross-like intersection appears near the center.
records.reason: 세 arm이 만나는 Y 모양이며 네 방향으로 교차하는 cross 형태는 아니다.
records.combination: The single role describes the visible stroke intersection.

records.name: Compact filled block
records.claim: A compact light square block is visible.
records.reason: 대부분 밝은 영역이지만 square block이라는 외곽은 창 경계에 의해 정해진다.
records.combination: A_C008 describes the compact filled region; its light polarity is an observed attribute, not a separate concept.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Vertical stroke orientation
records.claim: A compact bright mark is mainly vertical.
records.reason: 실제 밝은 세로 조각에 별도 세로 방향 concept을 적용했다.
records.combination: The orientation attribute B1_C003 describes the light-stroke instance B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Horizontal stroke orientation
records.claim: A short bright bar runs mainly horizontally.
records.reason: 아래쪽의 밝은 가로 구간에 가로 방향 concept을 적용한 설명은 가능하다.
records.combination: The horizontal orientation B1_C004 applies to the light-stroke instance B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Diagonal stroke orientation
records.claim: A narrow bright segment is slanted diagonally.
records.reason: 짧은 세로 조각들이 보이며 대각선으로 이어진 좁은 획은 없다.
records.combination: The diagonal orientation B1_C005 describes the light-stroke instance B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Curved stroke trajectory
records.claim: A bright C-like arc appears in the visible window.
records.reason: 넓은 밝은 덩어리와 내부 회색 픽셀은 보이지만 열린 C 모양의 획인지는 불분명하다.
records.combination: The curved trajectory B1_C006 describes the path of the light mark B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Angular bend
records.claim: A light mark changes direction through a small corner.
records.reason: 경계에 잘린 작은 밝은 조각에서 뚜렷한 두 선분과 corner를 구별하기 어렵다.
records.combination: The angular bend B1_C007 relates two differently oriented portions of the light mark B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Multi-arm junction
records.claim: A compact bright mark has multiple joined arms.
records.reason: 오른쪽의 세로 띠 하나이며 여러 arm이 연결된 junction은 없다.
records.combination: The junction relationship B1_C008 connects the visible arms within the light mark B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Loop-like enclosure
records.claim: A rounded light contour surrounds a small dark interior.
records.reason: 위아래로 열린 어두운 구간을 밝은 contour가 둘러싼 내부라고 설명했다.
records.combination: The enclosure property B1_C009 describes how the light mark B1_C001 surrounds the darker interior.

records.name: Predominantly dark field
records.claim: The visible window is almost entirely black.
records.reason: 왼쪽 위에 넓은 밝은 영역이 있어 창이 거의 전부 검정이라는 설명은 맞지 않는다.
records.combination: The visible pixels are represented by the predominantly dark field B1_C002.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Vertical stroke orientation
records.claim: A thin upright bright segment is visible against a dark field.
records.reason: 밝은 영역이 여러 방향으로 연결돼 있어 이를 얇은 세로 획 하나로 특정하기 어렵다.
records.combination: B1_C003 specifies the vertical direction of the B1_C001 mark.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Horizontal stroke orientation
records.claim: A short bright horizontal segment is visible.
records.reason: 중앙에 좌우로 이어진 밝은 연결부가 보인다.
records.combination: B1_C004 specifies the horizontal direction of the B1_C001 mark.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Curved stroke trajectory
records.claim: A curved bright stroke bends through the window.
records.reason: 아래쪽으로 넓어지는 밝은 조각은 있지만 잘린 범위에서 곡선 획인지 확정하기 어렵다.
records.combination: B1_C006 specifies the curved path taken by B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Multi-arm junction
records.claim: A small cross-like bright junction is visible.
records.reason: 굵은 대각선 하나가 보이며 cross 모양의 교차는 없다.
records.combination: B1_C008 specifies the multi-arm connection within B1_C001.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Curved stroke trajectory
records.claim: A small bright curved stroke forms a U-like arc.
records.reason: 밝은 획이 아래에서 굽으며 U와 비슷한 열린 형태를 만든다.
records.combination: The trajectory role describes the curvature of the mark role.

records.name: Light stroke fragment + Diagonal stroke orientation
